This description serves as a public history of the project: any reader must be able to understand it, even without any knowledge of code. Code is not discussed here: it is looked at during the review.

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Victor-root/AukDialer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] This PR contains only one change: a fix, a feature, or a cleanup.
- [ ] I tested the change on a real phone with a SIM card.
- [ ] If this PR touches the interface, it fits the rest of the app (spacing, alignment, colors).

## What it changes

Which problem this PR solves, and what changes for the user.

## Testing

Tell us the phone, the Android version, the carrier, and what you actually did: the case you changed, but also the essentials around it (incoming call, outgoing call, hanging up from both sides). Saying only that it works is not enough.

## AI assistance

If an AI was used for this PR, say so here, and how you checked the result.
